raw_text:
NEHA BHATIA
Aspiring Content Creation
+91 98123 45620 | neha.bhatia2024@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/nehabhatia-dev | github.com/nehabhatia-dev | Pune, Maharashtra
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Creative and versatile B.Tech student experienced in writing, scripting, and producing content across blogs, social media, and video formats. Skilled at translating technical and lifestyle topics into engaging content. Seeking a Content Creation Internship to grow brand voice and audience reach.
EDUCATION
Bachelor of Mass Media — Journalism & Communication | 2022 – 2025 (Expected)
Symbiosis Institute of Media and Communication, Pune CGPA: 8.45 / 10.0
Relevant Coursework: Feature Writing, Editorial Design, Media Research, SEO Writing, Public Relations
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Content Types: Blog Writing, Scriptwriting, Social Captions, Newsletters
Tools: Canva, Notion, Grammarly, WordPress, CapCut
Skills: SEO Basics, Storytelling, Research, Editorial Calendars
Other: Basic Photography, Audacity (Podcast Editing)
EXPERIENCE
Content Creation Intern — Synapse Analytics Pvt. Ltd., Pune | June 2024 – July 2024
Wrote 15+ blog articles on AI and tech trends, increasing organic blog traffic by 30%.
Scripted short-form videos for social channels, contributing to a 20% rise in engagement.
Maintained an editorial calendar coordinating content across 3 platforms.
PROJECTS
Tech Blog Series | WordPress, SEO Jan 2024 – Mar 2024
Published 10 SEO-optimised articles on ML and career topics, reaching 4,200+ reads on Medium.
Researched and fact-checked technical content for accuracy and clarity.
Brand Newsletter Revamp | Notion, Mailchimp Sep 2023 – Nov 2023
Redesigned a monthly newsletter format, increasing open rate from 18% to 32%.
Wrote concise, engaging copy tailored to a student audience.
Campus Podcast Series | Audacity, Canva Jul 2023 – Aug 2023
Co-produced a 6-episode podcast on student entrepreneurship, scripted and edited each episode.
Promoted episodes via social teasers, growing listenership steadily across the series.
CERTIFICATIONS
Content Strategy for Professionals — Northwestern University — Coursera Completed: Aug 2023
Writing for the Web, Score: 84/100 — NPTEL (IIT Madras) Completed: Nov 2023
Google Digital Marketing & E-commerce — IBM / Coursera Completed: May 2023
ACHIEVEMENTS & AWARDS
Selected among 80 students college-wide for the Smart India Hackathon (SIH 2024) internal round.
Received the Academic Excellence Award for Semester 2 with the highest GPA (9.3) in the CSE department cohort of 120 students.
Active contributor to two college-wide technical fests, coordinating logistics and technical sessions for 150+ participants.
EXTRACURRICULAR ACTIVITIES
Core Member, Technical Club, VIT Pune — organised hands-on workshops for 150+ students (2023–Present).
Technical Blogger — published articles on Medium covering tools and best practices relevant to the field; collectively read 4,000+ times.
Volunteer Mentor, CodeForGood (NGO Initiative) — guided 15 high school students through technology fundamentals over an 8-week programme.
